--- DIFF ---
diff --git a/relayer-cli/jest.config.ts b/relayer-cli/jest.config.ts
index bfc1d7b..b4d3fd0 100644
--- a/relayer-cli/jest.config.ts
+++ b/relayer-cli/jest.config.ts
@@ -5,6 +5,10 @@ const config: Config = {
   testEnvironment: "node",
   collectCoverage: true,
   collectCoverageFrom: ["**/*.ts"],
+  // Must be `setupFiles` (not `setupFilesAfterEnv`): jest.setup.ts only assigns
+  // process.env RPC defaults, and consts/bridgeRoutes.ts reads them at module
+  // load time, so they have to exist before any test module is imported.
+  setupFiles: ["<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts"],
   moduleNameMapper: {
     "^consts/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/consts/$1",
   },
diff --git a/relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts b/relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts
index b01f0bc..fb78ae1 100644
--- a/relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts
+++ b/relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,15 @@
+// Offline test defaults. Loaded via `setupFiles` in jest.config.ts, i.e. before any
+// test module is imported, because consts/bridgeRoutes.ts reads these at module load
+// time and throws MissingEnvironmentVariable otherwise.
+//
+// These URLs are unroutable placeholders: every test mocks its providers, so nothing
+// here is ever dialled. A real RPC in the environment is still honoured.
 process.env.RPC_ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA = process.env.RPC_ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA || "https://rpc.test";
 process.env.RPC_SEPOLIA = process.env.RPC_SEPOLIA || "https://rpc.test";
 process.env.RPC_CHIADO = process.env.RPC_CHIADO || "https://rpc.test";
+
+// relay.ts guards on PRIVATE_KEY before reaching its injected (mocked) signer factories,
+// so the offline suite needs one. Deliberately assigned unconditionally, NOT `||`-defaulted:
+// a real operator key must never be pulled into a test process. This is the publicly
+// documented Hardhat/Anvil account #0 key and holds no value on any live network.
+process.env.PRIVATE_KEY = "0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80";

relayer-fix-1: load offline test environment before imports

Static review of fix/val-doc-1 (67a87fc) … task/relayer-fix-1 (11ae13a) · 2 files · 16 additions

TL;DR

The patch registers the existing relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts as a Jest setupFiles entry, so RPC placeholders exist before test modules import bridgeRoutes.ts. It also installs a known test-only private key so relayBatch passes its environment guard while dependencies remain mocked. This directly addresses import-time MissingEnvironmentVariable failures without changing production code.

Contents jest.config.ts jest.setup.ts Verdict Residual findings

relayer-cli/jest.config.ts

Change: adds one Jest lifecycle hook:

setupFiles: ["<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts"],

Why: src/consts/bridgeRoutes.ts calls requireRpcEnv(...) while its module is being loaded. Both affected tests import modules that ultimately import that route table. Without RPC variables already present, collection fails before the tests or their mocks can run.

Why this hook: Jest runs setupFiles before test modules. That ordering is the substance of the fix; setupFilesAfterEnv would be later than necessary for import-time configuration.

relayer-cli/jest.setup.ts

Change: retains the three pre-existing RPC defaults, documents their lifecycle, and adds a fixed test private key:

process.env.RPC_ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA = process.env.RPC_ARBITRUM_SEPOLIA || "https://rpc.test";
process.env.RPC_SEPOLIA = process.env.RPC_SEPOLIA || "https://rpc.test";
process.env.RPC_CHIADO = process.env.RPC_CHIADO || "https://rpc.test";

process.env.PRIVATE_KEY = "0xac0974…f2ff80";
  • RPC behavior: a caller-supplied value is preserved; otherwise the suite gets a .test placeholder. These values satisfy requireRpcEnv when bridgeRoutes.ts initializes.
  • Private-key behavior: the setup deliberately overwrites any inherited PRIVATE_KEY with the public Hardhat/Anvil account #0 key. This prevents a real operator key from entering the Jest process and lets relayBatch pass its explicit private-key check.
  • Scope: all changes are test configuration. Runtime relayer configuration and route validation are untouched.

Review verdict: Approve

The lifecycle choice matches the failure mode, the path is rooted correctly for the relayer-cli Jest config, and the test key handling is safer than inheriting a real secret. The implementation is small and aligned with the stated acceptance criterion.

Residual findings

  • Verification limitation: this verdict is based on the diff and surrounding code. The Jest suite was not executed because the assignment allowed read-only Git inspection only.
  • Low-risk environment dependence: RPC values use fallback semantics, so pre-set CI RPC URLs remain visible to tests. The reviewed affected tests inject or mock their working dependencies, and no changed code introduces network calls; nevertheless, unconditional placeholders would be more hermetic if future tests begin using default providers.
  • No blocking findings: no production behavior, API, or deployment configuration changed.
